infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FindEat uses your camera so you can capture food posts and profile photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FindEat uses your photo library so you can choose photos and short videos for posts and your profile.

plugins.photosPermission: FindEat uses your photo library so you can choose photos and short videos for posts, reviews, dishes, and your profile.
plugins.cameraPermission: FindEat uses your camera so you can capture photos for posts and reviews.

plugins.photosPermission: FindEat uses your photo library when you choose media for posts, reviews, dishes, Snaps, and your profile.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: FindEat saves photos to your gallery only when you choose Save to gallery.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FindEat uses your location to show nearby restaurants, calculate distance, and recognize likely restaurant visits when enabled.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: When Visit Detection is enabled, FindEat uses region monitoring to recognize likely restaurant visits and remind you afterwards, even when the app is not open.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: When Visit Detection is enabled, FindEat uses region monitoring to recognize likely restaurant visits and remind you afterwards, even when the app is not open.
